_help: Act 2, the hotel (one action): where the rivals stay (heard_rival_rooms) and a quiet Italian guest (heard_italians). For 5, Clara keeps an eye on them (clara_watching, an Act 7 lead). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

start.speaker: clara
start.line: I don't gossip about my guests, monsieur. But I do talk about the weather, and the weather this week is crowded.

rivals.speaker: clara
rivals.line: Americans on the second floor, loud and generous. A German professor and his men on the third, up at dawn, maps on every table. And a gentleman who signs as Signor Rossi and never leaves his room before dark.

choices.label: Ask her to keep watch
choices.line: Keep an eye on them for me? It's worth a few pounds.

watch.speaker: clara
watch.line: For my best guest, I notice things. It is a hotelier's habit.
